claims.text: NASA ordered Boeing's Starliner to return uncrewed from its first crewed flight because the spacecraft experienced five reaction-control system (RCS) thruster anomalies during its docking approach on 2024-06-05 [Source: ev-1].

NASA announced this decision on 2024/08/24, stating that the safety of these thrusters could not be guaranteed for the deorbit burn since they could not be ground-tested in their flight condition [Source: ev-1].
